record.note: Reviewed the merged workflow text for minimal complete changes and evidence-based review alongside the preserved language and writing requirements and five-type Issue lifecycle. Reuse respects responsibility boundaries; simplification preserves required behavior and validation. Writing guidance remains one incremental authority without style gates; non-blocking advice adds no approval or evidence chain. Classification remains separate from execution permission. Unchanged sections retain existing authority. This review covers the integrated workflow text and AGENTS navigation; it does not attest repository-wide semantics, live label configuration, historical Issue migration, scheduler activation, or runtime behavior. Bounded follow-up review covers the new section 3 CI layering paragraph and its links to the fast-PR/periodic-full requirements and design. Independent review found it consistent with section 1 authority and effective-protection rules and the preserved section 3 scope selection, failure propagation, source identity, read-only PR permissions, independent review, and main-advance rules. It adds no admission, approval chain, or state ledger and does not activate the schedule, relax current checks, or attest the latency target, full coverage, or release-result consumption.
